text: Being here, I am enveloped by the energy of creation and inquiry. The countdown timer behind the glass hints at a sense of anticipation, a reminder of how time shapes our experience and efforts. Upon entering, the vibrant R+D wall further immerses me in thoughtful curiosity. Here, ideas and innovation seem not just displayed, but alive, urging me to ponder how humans and technology continually reshape one another. I feel inspired, yet also questioning the pace and direction of this evolution.
